gloss: to drive; to spur on; to compel

definitions.gloss: to drive; to spur on; to urge forward
definitions.explanation: To drive or urge an animal (especially a horse) or vehicle forward. A literary or formal word for propelling something.

definitions.gloss: to compel; to impel; to be driven by
definitions.explanation: To be urged or driven to action by an emotion or impulse. Often used in the passive form {駆|か}られる to describe being overcome by a feeling.

notes:
A godan verb. Sense 2 (passive form {駆|か}られる) is the more common modern usage.

SENSE 1 (drive/spur):
Literary and somewhat archaic for the horse-riding meaning, but still used for driving vehicles in a dynamic, literary style.

SENSE 2 (compel):
Very common in the passive pattern 「X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}られる」 (be driven by X).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{好奇心|こうきしん}→好奇心：05213_koukishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}られる (be driven by curiosity)
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}られる (be gripped by anxiety)
- ⟦{衝動|しょうどう}→衝動：07622_shoudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}られる (be driven by impulse)
- ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}られる (be driven by anger)
- ⟦{焦|あせ}り→焦り：05812_aseri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}られる (be driven by impatience)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧ (to run/dash) is intransitive, while {駆|か}る is transitive. {追|お}い{立|た}てる (to drive out/chase) implies forceful pushing, while {駆|か}る focuses on the inner force or motivation.
